info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Update Operational Service Parameters API allows users to adjust specific operational services identified by unique parameters. This endpoint is essential for maintaining the accuracy and relevance of service offerings, enabling financial institutions to tailor their card collections effectively. Typical consumers include banking partners, system integrators, and operational teams looking to enhance service configurations. The API supports dynamic updates to operational parameters, ensuring that banking services are responsive to changing business needs.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific card collection by its unique identifier. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields that need to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to update the state of the card collection identified by CARD-400045. It allows for the modification of various attributes related to the card collection.
